svg.title: Academy Town (academy-town) plan v1, 200 x 200 m, x east, z south
svg.desc: Top-down layout of the Academy Town biome. 5 px = 1 m. Structure inspired by the MIT campus references; all forms original toybox low-poly. Palette from docs/design/world/biomes/academy-town.md.
svg.text: ACADEMY TOWN · plan v1 · 200 × 200 m, 5 px = 1 m
x east → z south ↓ settled ground y = 0 (never rises) camera arrives from the south over the river
HALL SKYLINE — grows with course fraction: 4 halls 8 m → 12 halls 12 m, bell tower 10 → 26 m, back row of towers and 3 small domes in fog
100 m lane · arcade of 25 columns · 12 halls · 8 poster boards
s1 lectern → s2 reading hall → s3 dome hall
lawn 28 × 54 m · axis path · 6 halls · 16 trees · geese
2 wave + 2 grid + 2 block dorms · chapel · boathouse + dock
RIVER · 48 m wide · flows east → · 4 sailboats + 1 rowing shell (ambient)
river road 5 m · river walk · lamps every 8 m
